description: Start a credit purchase for the connection's Dagon key, paid in USDC on Solana from payer_wallet (POST /v1/credits/purchase). This server never signs: it returns the unsigned transaction for payer_wallet to sign. Submit it to Solana yourself, then pass its signature to dagon_confirm_purchase. The wallet pays the Solana network fee (under $0.01), so it needs at least 0.0005 SOL besides the USDC.

amount_usd.description: Amount to buy in USD (whole cents, e.g. 5 or 12.5).

payer_wallet.description: Base58 Solana address that pays and signs.

name: dagon_buy_credits
title: Buy Dagon credits with Solana USDC
